---
title: "Woodworking · Roadmap"
---

The order I'm learning things in — each stage builds on the last.

```{mermaid}
graph TD
  A[Sharpening] --> B[Sawing to a line]
  B --> C[Planing flat & square]
  C --> D[Basic joints]
  D --> E[First furniture piece]
```

1. **Sharpening** — nothing else works without it.
2. **Sawing to a line** — rip and crosscut, staying on the waste side.
3. **Planing flat & square** — reference faces and edges.
4. **Basic joints** — mortise & tenon, then dovetails.
5. **First furniture piece** — put it all together.
